brief.audience: Mobile sellers, makers, and creators who need to clean up product photos fast and are likely to use AI editing repeatedly on day one.
brief.hook: Turn dull phone product shots into bright, sharp, well-lit listing photos in one tap.
avoid: Third-party logo styling: keep out; Lumen brand colour is #6C4CF5
why: Product photos are the strongest onboarding goal with 22.9% paid and $10.32/user across 4913 users.
product_photos × apple_search_ads is the top segment with 39.5% paid, $19.61/user, and 3.8% refunds across 397 users.
People making 5-7 AI edits on day one reach 33% paid and $15.47/user, while 13+ edits reach 35.8% paid and $16.97/user.
apple_search_ads leads paid channels with 32.1% paid and $15.03/user, while google_uac has 4526 users and $8.64/user for scale.
NL, US, DE, SE, GB, CA, AU, and FR all have at least 482 users and range from $10.85/user to $15.28/user.
